header.note: RAW pandoc truth for `::: <spec>` openers; synthetic specs only. spec is the text after the colon run minus the one space the generator adds, UNTRIMMED, TABs unexpanded; the opener is indent spaces + ':::' + ' ' + spec (tailCol = indent + 3). oneLine framing: opener / blank / x / blank / :::. continuation framing: opener / } / blank / x / blank / :::. kind: attr = a Div with pandoc's Attr; word = a Div whose only class is the tail's first word (fallback true iff the word starts with '{'); refused = no Div. kvs hold pandoc's DECODED values. pandoc 3.6.3 refuses every INDENTED opener (indent 1-3), so indent>0 rows are all refused.
